## Load Packages

```{r}
setwd("~/R Studio/NSAS Herring/NSAS-Herring")

library(bcp)
library(changepoint)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(FSA)
library(strucchange)
library(MASS)
library(hydroGOF)
library(mgcv)
library(INDperform)
library(gridExtra)
```

## Import data

```{r}
load("data/Herring_LAI.Rdata")

### Load functions from "functions"
source("R/functions.R")

### Split data into components
Herring <- list()
Herring$SHOR <- Herring_LAI[Herring_LAI$component == "Shetland_Orkney",]
Herring$Buchan <- Herring_LAI[Herring_LAI$component == "Buchan",]
Herring$Banks <- Herring_LAI[Herring_LAI$component == "Banks",]
Herring$Downs <- Herring_LAI[Herring_LAI$component == "Downs",]
```

# Change-points

## Identify change-points

```{r}
### Call function "changepoint_analysis" from functions

### Shetland Orkney
results_cpt <- list()
results_cpt$SHOR <- changepoint_analysis(Herring$SHOR, 
                                          region_name = "Shetland/Orkney",
                                          year_col = "year",
                                          Q = 6,
                                          bcp_threshold = 0.7)
# CPT changepoint indices:  12,   19,   23,   25,   34,   43 
# CPT changepoint years:    1983, 1990, 1994, 1996, 2005, 2014 

# BCP changepoint indices:  12,   19,   23,   31,   34,   43 
# BCP changepoint years:    1983, 1990, 1994, 2002, 2005, 2014 

# Consensus changepoints (± 1 yr, min 5 yr apart): 1983, 1990, 2005, 2014 
# CPT only: 1994, 1996 
# BCP only: 1994, 2002

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Buchan
results_cpt$Buchan <- changepoint_analysis(Herring$Buchan, 
                                          region_name = "Buchan",
                                          year_col = "year",
                                          Q = 6,
                                          bcp_threshold = 0.7)
# CPT changepoint indices:  15,   18,   22,   38,   40,   47 
# CPT changepoint years:    1986, 1989, 1993, 2009, 2011, 2018 

## BCP Analysis
# BCP changepoint indices:  18,   21,   23,   39,   46 
# BCP changepoint years:    1989, 1992, 1994, 2010, 2017 

## Consensus Analysis
# Consensus changepoints (± 1 yr, min 5 yr apart): 1989, 2009, 2018 
# CPT only: 1986, 1993, 2011 
# BCP only: 1992, 1994, 2010, 2017

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Banks
results_cpt$Banks <- changepoint_analysis(Herring$Banks, 
                                          region_name = "Banks",
                                          year_col = "year",
                                          Q = 6,
                                          bcp_threshold = 0.7)
# CPT changepoint indices:  11,   19,   29,   34,   38,   48 
# CPT changepoint years:    1982, 1990, 2000, 2005, 2009, 2019 

## BCP Analysis
# BCP changepoint indices:  12,   19,   29,   30,   34 
# BCP changepoint years:    1983, 1990, 2000, 2001, 2005 

## Consensus Analysis
# Consensus changepoints (± 1 yr, min 5 yr apart): 1982, 1990, 2000, 2005 
# CPT only: 2009, 2019 
# BCP only: 1983, 2001

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Downs
results_cpt$Downs <- changepoint_analysis(Herring$Downs, 
                                          region_name = "Downs",
                                          year_col = "year",
                                          Q = 6,
                                          bcp_threshold = 0.7)
# CPT changepoint indices:  16,   28,   30,   40,   44,   49 
# CPT changepoint years:    1987, 1999, 2001, 2011, 2015, 2020 

## BCP Analysis
# BCP changepoint indices:  30,   40 
# BCP changepoint years:    2001, 2011 

## Consensus Analysis
# Consensus changepoints (± 1 yr, min 5 yr apart): 2001, 2011 
# CPT only: 1987, 1999, 2015, 2020  
```

### Save plots

```{r}

ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SSB_cpt_components.png"),
       plot = grid.arrange(
         plots_SSB_cpt$SHOR + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank()),
         plots_SSB_cpt$Buchan + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank()),
         plots_SSB_cpt$Banks + theme(axis.title.x = element_text(), axis.title.y = element_blank()),
         plots_SSB_cpt$Downs + theme(axis.title.x = element_text(), axis.title.y = element_blank()),
         ncol = 2,
         bottom = "Year",
         left = "SSB in million t"),
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Hysteresis

## Analysis

```{r}
 # Create time-lag object using specified lag
  data$SSB_lag <- lag(data[[ssb_col]], lag_years)
  
  if (!is.null(dataset_name)) {
    assign(dataset_name, data, envir = parent.frame())}

### Examine for time lag
ccf(Herring$SHOR$SSB_component, Herring$SHOR$F, type = "correlation") # 1 year lag
Herring$SHOR$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring$SHOR$SSB_component, 1)

ccf(Herring$Buchan$SSB_component, Herring$Buchan$F, type = "correlation") # 3 years lag
Herring$Buchan$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring$Buchan$SSB_component, 3)

ccf(Herring$Banks$SSB_component, Herring$Banks$F, type = "correlation") # 5 years lag
Herring$Banks$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring$Banks$SSB_component, 5)

ccf(Herring$Downs$SSB_component, Herring$Downs$F, type = "correlation") # 1 year lag
Herring$Downs$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring$Downs$SSB_component, 1)

#---------------------------------------------------------------------
### Call function "breakpoint_analysis"

### Shetland Orkney
results_brkpt <- list()
results_brkpt$SHOR <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring$SHOR, "SSB_component", "F", "year",
                                               lag_years = 1,
                                               region_name = "Shetland Orkney")

# Optimal number of breaks: 5 
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.28 0.29 0.189 0.29 0.22 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1983, 1990, 1997, 2005, 2015
#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Buchan
results_brkpt$Buchan <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring$Buchan, "SSB_component", "F", "year", 
                                    lag_years = 3, 
                                    region_name = "Buchan")
# Optimal number of breaks: 3
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.29 0.189 0.184 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1990, 1997, 2012 
#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Banks
results_brkpt$Banks <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring$Banks, "SSB_component", "F", "year", 
                                    lag_years = 5, 
                                    region_name = "Banks")
# Optimal number of breaks: 2
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.39 0.29 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1988, 2005 
#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Downs
results_brkpt$Downs <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring$Downs, "SSB_component", "F", "year", 
                                    lag_years = 1, 
                                    region_name = "Downs")
# Optimal number of breaks: 4 
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.41 0.171 0.073 0.24 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1987, 2002, 2009, 2016 
```

## Plotting

```{r}
### Call function plot_hysteresis 
plots_hysteresis <- list()

plots_hysteresis$SHOR <- plot_hysteresis(Herring$SHOR, results_brkpt$SHOR$break_years, "Shetland Orkneys", show_msy_btrigger = FALSE)
plots_hysteresis$SHOR

plots_hysteresis$Buchan <- plot_hysteresis(Herring$Buchan, results_brkpt$Buchan$break_years, "Buchan", show_msy_btrigger = FALSE)
plots_hysteresis$Buchan

plots_hysteresis$Banks <- plot_hysteresis(Herring$Banks, results_brkpt$Banks$break_years, "Banks", show_msy_btrigger = FALSE)
plots_hysteresis$Banks

plots_hysteresis$Downs <- plot_hysteresis(Herring$Downs, results_brkpt$Downs$break_years, "Downs", show_msy_btrigger = FALSE)
plots_hysteresis$Downs
```

### save plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "hysteresis_components.png"),
       plot = gridExtra::grid.arrange(plots_hysteresis$SHOR, 
                                      plots_hysteresis$Buchan, 
                                      plots_hysteresis$Banks, 
                                      plots_hysteresis$Downs, ncol = 2),
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# SRR Non-Stationary

## Analysis

```{r}
### Load model comparison from model_comp_functions.R 
source("R/model_comp_functions.R")

### Shetland Okrney
#### Compare different models
models_SRR <- list()
models_SRR$SHOR <- run_srr_analysis(
  data_for_srr = Herring$SHOR,
  recruit_col = "R",
  ssb_col = "SSB_lag",
  opt_brks_val = 5)

print(models_SRR$SHOR$comparison_table)

#### strucchange model shows lowest RMSE

# Call function "srr_breakpoint_analysis" to extract SSR breakpoints
results_SRR <- list()
results_SRR$SHOR <- srr_breakpoint_analysis(Herring$SHOR, "SSB_lag", "R", "year", "Shetland Orkney")

# Optimal number of breaks: 3 
# Best breakpoint SSB values:
# 138883, 473458.6, 997291.1 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1980,   1987,     1998

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Buchan
#### Compare different models
models_SRR$Buchan <- run_srr_analysis(
  data_for_srr = Herring$Buchan,
  recruit_col = "R",
  ssb_col = "SSB_lag",
  opt_brks_val = 3)

print(models_SRR$Buchan$comparison_table)

#### strucchange model shows lowest RMSE

# Call function "srr_breakpoint_analysis" to extract SSR breakpoints
results_SRR$Buchan <- srr_breakpoint_analysis(Herring$Buchan, "SSB_lag", "R", "year", "Buchan")

# Optimal number of breaks: 2 
# Best breakpoint SSB values:
# 4041.6, 16832.7 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1981,   2002 

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Banks
#### Compare different models
models_SRR$Banks <- run_srr_analysis(
  data_for_srr = Herring$Banks,
  recruit_col = "R",
  ssb_col = "SSB_lag",
  opt_brks_val = 2)

print(models_SRR$Banks$comparison_table)

#### strucchange model shows lowest RMSE

# Call function "srr_breakpoint_analysis" to extract SSR breakpoints
results_SRR$Banks <- srr_breakpoint_analysis(Herring$Banks, "SSB_lag", "R", "year", "Banks")

# Optimal number of breaks: 2 
# Best breakpoint SSB values:
# 32274.4,  56591.4 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1983,     2002

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Banks
#### Compare different models
models_SRR$Downs <- run_srr_analysis(
  data_for_srr = Herring$Downs,
  recruit_col = "R",
  ssb_col = "SSB_lag",
  opt_brks_val = 2)

print(models_SRR$Downs$comparison_table)

#### segmented regression model shows lowest RMSE

# Call function "srr_breakpoint_analysis" to extract SSR breakpoints
results_SRR$Downs <- srr_breakpoint_analysis(Herring$Downs, "SSB_lag", "R", "year", "Banks", method = "segmented")

# Running segmented model analysis
# Using mean SSB as initial psi: 305881.4 
# Segmented model breakpoint:
# SSB breakpoint:   25587.2 ± 3723 
# Approximate year: 1982 
```

## Plotting

```{r}
### Call "plot_SRR" function from functions.R
### Shetland Orkney
plots_SRR <- list()
plots_SRR$SHOR <- plot_SRR(Herring$SHOR, break_years = results_SRR$SHOR$break_years,
                          title_stock = "Shetland Orkney", 
                          used_model = "strucchange", 
                          ssb_col = "SSB_component",
                          show_Blim = FALSE,
                          nudge_params = list(
                            list(nudge_y = -8, nudge_x = 0.1),    # first year
```

# tGAM

```{r}
### Load env data
load("data/env_df_subset.Rdata")

### Shetland Orkney
#### Merge env data to fish
tGAM <- list()
tGAM$SHOR <- merge(Herring$SHOR, env_df_subset[env_df_subset$Region == "Shetland_Orkney",],by = "year") %>%
  dplyr::select(year, SSB_lag, R, Mean_SST, Mean_SBT, Mean_SSS)

#### Run threshold gam function from "functions" with each variable
run_threshold_gam(tGAM$SHOR, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SST", "year") # FALSE, 9.631367
run_threshold_gam(tGAM$SHOR, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SBT", "year") # FALSE, 8.684516
run_threshold_gam(tGAM$SHOR, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SSS", "year") # FALSE, 35.22361

#### No significant threshold effect found

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Buchan
#### Merge env data to fish
tGAM$Buchan <- merge(Herring$Buchan, env_df_subset[env_df_subset$Region == "Buchan",],by = "year") %>%
  dplyr::select(year, SSB_lag, R, Mean_SST, Mean_SBT, Mean_SSS)

#### Run threshold gam function from "functions" with each variable
run_threshold_gam(tGAM$Buchan, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SST", "year") # FALSE, 10.10035
run_threshold_gam(tGAM$Buchan, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SBT", "year") # TRUE,  8.593926
run_threshold_gam(tGAM$Buchan, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SSS", "year") # FALSE, 34.67423

#### Significant threshold effect found for SBT at 8.6°C

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Banks
#### Merge env data to fish
tGAM$Banks <- merge(Herring$Banks, env_df_subset[env_df_subset$Region == "Banks",],by = "year") %>%
  dplyr::select(year, SSB_lag, R, Mean_SST, Mean_SBT, Mean_SSS)

#### Run threshold gam function from "functions" with each variable
run_threshold_gam(tGAM$Banks, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SST", "year") # FALSE, 10.25506
run_threshold_gam(tGAM$Banks, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SBT", "year") # FALSE, 9.65014
run_threshold_gam(tGAM$Banks, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SSS", "year") # FALSE, 34.83148

#### No significant threshold effect found

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Downs
#### Merge env data to fish
tGAM$Downs <- merge(Herring$Downs, env_df_subset[env_df_subset$Region == "Downs",],by = "year") %>%
  dplyr::select(year, SSB_lag, R, Mean_SST, Mean_SBT, Mean_SSS)

#### Run threshold gam function from "functions" with each variable
run_threshold_gam(tGAM$Downs, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SST", "year") # FALSE, 11.89771
run_threshold_gam(tGAM$Downs, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SBT", "year") # FALSE, 11.8788
run_threshold_gam(tGAM$Downs, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SSS", "year") # FALSE, 33.42736

#### No significant threshold effect found
```
